newsitem.title: USA: Health Risk wins workers' comp nod.
newsitem.headline: Health Risk wins workers' comp nod.

text.p: Health Risk Management Inc said Tuesday it was certified by the Ohio Bureau of Workers' Compensation to market its services to Ohio employers.

Health Risk Management, a health care benefits management company, became one of the 52 such service providers authorized by regulators in Ohio to market administrative and clinical management services to businesses.

Under a 1993 Ohio statute, all employers must select a certified managed care organization to handle workers' compensation claims by February 15, 1997. Health Risk Management operates 230 facilities in Ohio.
